plain_text:
Within the Golden Radio Hour archive, Jack Moyles is credited on 339 distinct recordings across 22 programs from 1943-10-24 through 1960-11-20. Documented roles include performer on 337 recordings, commercial spokesman on 2 recordings, and writer on 1 recordings.

The strongest program connections in the current GRH holdings are Rocky Jordan (performer on 82 recordings; 82 distinct recordings), Wild Bill Hickok (performer on 56 recordings and commercial spokesman on 2 recordings; 58 distinct recordings), Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar (performer on 38 recordings; 38 distinct recordings), The Line Up (performer on 27 recordings; 27 distinct recordings), The Whistler (performer on 20 recordings; 20 distinct recordings), Fibber McGee and Molly (performer on 18 recordings; 18 distinct recordings), Gunsmoke (performer on 17 recordings; 17 distinct recordings), and Fort Laramie (performer on 16 recordings; 16 distinct recordings).

Documented character portrayals include Rocky Jordan (82 portrayals), Sgt. Pete Karger (24 portrayals), and Major Daggett (15 portrayals).
